China-based AI group briefed US AI labs, including OpenAI

A China-based artificial intelligence safety group has briefed several US AI laboratories, including OpenAI. The group's activities have raised questions about Western perceptions of AI safety in China. The Financial Times suggests that the West may misunderstand the AI safety landscape in China.
